message.content: {"count":4,"rationale":"Blocking codeRepo:collection, dbReplica:collection, mailArchive:collection, and vaultRead:collection makes the target unreachable. At least four blocks are necessary because these four attack derivations have pairwise-disjoint blockable steps: (1) configSecret → backupHost → mailArchive; (2) iotDevice and kerberoast → apiToken → jumpHost → codeRepo; (3) mailClient and tokenCache → ssoLogin → printServer → vaultRead; (4) containerHost → memoryDump → monitoringHost → dbReplica. Each derivation is supported directly by unblocked entry footholds and reaches the target, so each requires a separate block."}
